title: Georgia Court Sentences Ex-Security Chief to 13 Years in Prison in Corruption Case

title: Former Maduro Ally Pleads Guilty in US to $195M Money Laundering Scheme
snippet: The guilty plea caps a years-long geopolitical saga, spanning a high-profile U.S. prisoner swap and validating early reporting into a corrupt Venezuelan state food program.

title: French Prosecutors Seek Up to 5 Years in Prison for Sons of Ex-Yemeni President Saleh Over Ill-Gotten Assets
snippet: French prosecutors are seeking prison sentences and the formal forfeiture of luxury Paris real estate and Swiss bank accounts, accusing the sons of late Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh of laundering millions in embezzled state funds.

title: Albania’s High Court Rules Against Tirana Mayor’s Release
snippet: Erion Veliaj suffers major legal setback as High Court rules that he should stay in pre-trial detention on corruption and money-laundering charges – even though he is still Tirana's acting mayor.
